questions.stem_markdown:
A cyclist and bicycle have a total mass of $72\text{ kg}$. The cyclist rides along a horizontal road against a total resistance force of $28\text{ N}$.

Find the total work done by the cyclist to increase his speed from $8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ to $16\text{ m s}^{-1}$ while travelling a distance of 100 metres.

questions.stem_markdown: Three particles $A$, $B$ and $C$ of masses $5\text{ kg}$, $1\text{ kg}$ and $2\text{ kg}$ respectively lie at rest in that order on a straight smooth horizontal track $XYZ$. Particle $A$ is projected towards $B$ with a speed of $6\text{ m s}^{-1}$ and at the same instant $C$ is projected towards $B$ with a speed of $\nu\text{ m s}^{-1}$.
